text.jp:
こんなに長い間戦ってきて、
つらいことばかりだったけど、いいこともあったよ。
text.official_en:
It's been a long, difficult fight. But there have been
bright moments too.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カイ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
たくさんの人と友達になれたし、
自分にはない考えをいっぱい教えてもらった。
text.official_en:
I made friends with lots of people. I was taught loads
of things that I never imagined.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カイ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
もちろん救世主様もその一人だよ。
かけがえのない大事な仲間だ。
text.official_en:
You were one of those teachers, Promised One.
Your companionship can't ever be replaced.

text.official_en: <TH>

マーズは、数年前の『サラミス王国を救援せよ』
という言葉を最後にあまり意向を示さなくなった。
text.official_en:
After Mars told us to rescue Saramis, he took a step
back from our affairs.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
神位の立場から、深く情勢に干渉することを
避けているんだ。人間に、世界を託すために。
text.official_en:
Fair enough. Gods may not be seen to interfere.
He wants to hand the world to us humans.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
“熱剣”を受け継いだ者として……
俺は、その期待に応えようと思う。
text.official_en:
As the inheritor of the Smoldering Sword, I feel
that I must meet his expectations.

text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
しかし、長く留まったものだ……
何か妹に土産が要るか……
text.official_en:
I have been in this land a long time now. Perhaps I
should send Elfrida a gift.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディートリヒ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
バロールの首……
いや、突き返されるのが関の山か……
text.official_en: Balor's head? No...she would likely send it right back.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディートリヒ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
まあいい……
あいつに文句を言われるのは常だ……
text.official_en:
What I do matters not. I am in for a lecture. There is
no doubt about that.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_タリムーン

text.jp:
しかし、俺様の血筋はどうなってるのかね。
ろくでもない奴ばっかじゃねえか？
text.official_en:
My bloodline has got to be the wildest mishmash
of good-for-nothings out there, right?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_タリムーン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
こんな奴が筆頭総支配人の商会なんざ、
俺様だったら、さっさと辞めてるところだ。
text.official_en:
If I had to work for any of my relatives, I'd quit so
fast it'd make their heads spin.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_タリムーン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だが、従業員もろくでもない奴しかいないらしい。
……いまだに残り続ける馬鹿ばっかなんだからな。
text.official_en:
Doubt they'd make decent employees either. End of
the day, I'm sure they'd ruin whatever they touch.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オルヘル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
アウロラは、今も無事でしょうか……戦争の折に、
ダグシオンからは脱出したと聞きましたが……
text.official_en:
I wonder if Aurora is safe. I heard she escaped from
Dagsion during the war.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オルヘル
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
アウロラや、その神官たちもまた、
バロールの脅威に立ち向かっていますわ。
text.official_en:
Aurora and her priests are also confronting Balor's
great evil.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オルヘル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
あなたと同じように、
人々の想いを一身に背負って……
text.official_en:
She is so like you, bearing the hopes of the people
on her shoulders.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オルヘル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
どうか……救世主様も、
気にかけてやってくださいましね？
text.official_en:
Promised One, please... Could you make sure that
she is looked after in all this?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
サラミス軍は、冥界がこの世界に
顕現した後も練度を高めてきた。
text.official_en:
The soldiers of Saramis have sharpened their skills
on the armies of the underworld.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
問答無用で押し寄せる実戦を生き抜いた者たちに、
更に鍛錬を施したのだ。強くならぬ道理がない。
text.official_en:
Those who survived the relentless battles were left all
the stronger for it.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
サラミスの戦士は死をも恐れぬ……
その誇りを持って皆戦ってきたが……
text.official_en:
Warriors of Saramis do not fear death. They gird
themselves in their pride like armor.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
願わくば、生き残った将兵らには
この戦を乗り越えてほしいものだ。
text.official_en:
I pray that the soldiers and generals who have
survived thus far see this war through to its end.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
瓦礫を見る度に故郷のことを思い出します。
泣きながら逃げるしかなかったカッシートを……
text.official_en:
I look at the rubble, and I remember my hometown,
Kassite. The place I fled from with tears in my eyes...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
でも亡者に襲われた街はあの街と違って
本当にすべての命が喪われる……
text.official_en:
But there's one difference. The risen dead scour
these towns and leave no one alive.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ふふふ、実は戦争中ずっと怒りで
どうにかなりそうなんですよね。
text.official_en:
Heh, this war makes me so infuriated, I don't know
what to do with all my anger.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
死んだ人たちの無念があたしに流れ込んで、
今にも溢れそう……そんな感覚です。
text.official_en:
I feel like I'm carrying the regrets of everyone
who died, and they're all spilling out.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アナトリア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
僕は里を出て、書籍などの電子的ではない
記録媒体が好きになりました。
text.official_en:
Since leaving the village, I've found a liking for old
analog technology, like books.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アナトリア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
製造には資源と技術を要する上、
質量に対して貯蔵できる情報量も少ないですが……
text.official_en:
It's true, they don't store as much information as a
digital file can, and they cost resources to produce.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アナトリア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
それを記した者の存在や、そのときの想いまでもが
伝わってくるように思えるのです。
text.official_en:
But reading from paper makes it feel like the author
is with you, sharing their feelings in real time.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アナトリア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
瓦礫の中から見つけた際には、
可能な限り回収、保存するようにしています。
text.official_en:
Whenever I find a book among the rubble, I do what
I can to collect it and get it to safety.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ

text.jp:
盤上遊戯では、勝利のために
あえて駒を切り捨てることがあります。
text.official_en:
When I'm playing games, sometimes I'll intentionally
sacrifice a piece if doing so will ensure victory.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
でも、それはあくまでも盤上でのこと。
現実にしたくはないですね。
text.official_en:
But that's a tactic I'd only ever practice on the board.
Never in reality where real lives are at stake.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
格好いい男になりたいって、子供の頃から思ってた。
実際なれたかどうかはまだわからないけどね。
text.official_en:
I've wanted to be a good-looking man ever since I
was a kid. But I'm not sure if I've become one.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
一つだけ確かなのは、この戦いがきついからって
逃げ出すような奴は格好悪い！　ってこと。
text.official_en:
One thing I do know is it's a bad look to flee from
battle just because it's tough!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……なんて。
自分に言い聞かせてるんだよ。必死にね。
text.official_en:
That's what I keep telling myself at least. If nothing
else, it keeps me in the fight.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド

text.jp:
ご飯や家があることも大事だけど……同じくらい、
お風呂に入ることも大切だと思います。
text.official_en:
There are three things I think are important. Food,
shelter, and a chance to bathe.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
特にダグシオンのテルマエは、
みんなにとって日常の象徴みたいなものです。
text.official_en: The Dagsion thermae were a symbol of everyday life.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees

ゆっくり温まれば、戦う気力も湧きます。
馬鹿にしたものじゃありませんよ。
text.official_en:
After relaxing in the warmth for a bit, you start to
feel like you can fight again. It's no small thing.

text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
騎士として戦に出るようになってから……
アラゴ王国で過ごしていた頃をよく思い出します。
text.official_en:
Since I joined this war as a knight, I've thought a lot
about my time in Arago.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
「陽炎の騎士団」にいた時期ではなく……
ベルトランさんに、武器の握り方を教えてもらい……
text.official_en:
I don't mean my time with the Order of the Haze,
but when Bertrand taught me how to hold a blade...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
お父上のガイガルドさんに、
騎士としての在り方を説いていただいていた時代を。
text.official_en:
and when his father, Geigart, told me the meaning
of knighthood.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
自分の経験すべてが今の糧になっているのだと、
実感しています。
text.official_en:
Those are the experiences that really made me who
I am today.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゴライアス

この間、街の外でクサリクを見つけたんだ。
締め上げて、飯の足しにしようと思ったんだが……
text.official_en:
The other day I ran into a kusarik outside the city.
Was plannin' to catch it and cook it up.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゴライアス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そこに亡者どもがわらわら来てよ。
いつの間にか、そいつと一緒に戦ってたんだ。
text.official_en:
But then the risen dead came shamblin' in. Before I
knew it, the kusarik and me were on the same side!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゴライアス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

全員ぶっ倒した後、野郎と睨み合って……
結局、見逃しちまった。
text.official_en:
Once we'd knocked out all of 'em, I gave the beastie
a long look...and then let him go.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゴライアス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
生きてるもん同士、一時休戦って奴だ。
次会ったら肉にして食ってやるけどな！　ブハハ！
text.official_en:
Just a short truce between the living. But if I see
it again, you know I'm havin' it for dinner! Bwahaha!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゲイツ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ここまで前代未聞の戦いとなると、
将軍として得た経験など、あまり役には立たない。
text.official_en:
In such an unprecedented war, I'm not certain my
experience as a general counts for much.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゲイツ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ダグザの地全土が冥界と成り果てた様など
歴戦の勇士でも見たことはないのだからな。
text.official_en:
No warrior—no matter how seasoned—has seen the
land of Dagda transformed into the underworld.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゲイツ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
だが……それでも不安がる兵たちの前では
頼りがいのある将軍として、立ち続けなければ。
text.official_en:
Still, we must stand before our anxious soldiers as
their confident leaders.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ダンテ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
写本屋も神殿も今はほとんど機能していない。
故にぼくの作品を世に広める手段が激減したわけだ。
text.official_en:
Most transcription houses and temples are
in disarray, making it difficult to publish my works.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ダンテ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
この数年で書き上げた戯曲の数は、
両の手の指では到底足りないというのに！
text.official_en:
Meanwhile, the plays I've written the last few years
exceeded what can be counted with all your fingers!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ダンテ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
傑作を待つ人々のためにも、
勝利と復興を目指さなければ！
text.official_en:
We must strive for victory, and restore the
apparatuses of publishing, for my audience's sake!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
神官の方々に『貴方の神にも祈らせてくれ』と
迫られ参りましたよ。
text.official_en:
Unbelievable. Everywhere I turn, some priest begs
me to lead them in prayer to the goddess.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
この皮を選んだのは、身分を偽るために
都合が良かったというだけだったのですが……
text.official_en:
I chose this skin as a convenient disguise—
nothing more.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
まさかこんな形で布教を求められる日が来るとは
想定外でした。
text.official_en:
I never anticipated I would be asked to perform as
a holy man...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
嫌なことがあったら海を見るといいよ。
大きいしずっと一緒にいてくれるから安心するよ。
text.official_en:
When something bad happens, just look at the sea to
calm down. It's big, and it's always there for you.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
それに海の向こうには、ダーリンの故郷……
フォドラの地があるんだよね……
text.official_en:
And on the other side of the sea is Sweetie's
home...Fódlan.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
いつか行ってみたいなあ。
良かったらあんたも一緒に来なよ。
text.official_en:
I really want to go there someday. You should
come too!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウーシュラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
戦う術はタリムーンに教わりました。
己の身を守る力が欲しかったので。
text.official_en:
Talimun's the one who taught me how to
defend myself.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウーシュラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
今となっては、
専ら他人を守るために使っていますが。
text.official_en:
Though, nowadays, I primarily use my abilities to
protect others.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウーシュラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……変わるものですね。かつての私は、
何も信じられない人間だったのに……
text.official_en:
How things change... To think I went from not
believing in anything to being who I am now.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シモン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
亡者の相手ばかりしてると、
自分が冥府にいるみたいに感じるぜ。
text.official_en:
Might sound crazy, but seeing so many dead all the
time almost makes me feel dead myself.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シモン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
おれはもう死んじまったのか？
って頭がおかしくなりそうにもなる。
text.official_en:
Did I already die? Am I trapped in the underworld?
Feels like I'm going crazy, honestly...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シモン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だが、あんたを見ると生きてることが実感できる。
頼りになるぜ。
text.official_en:
It's looking at you that lets me know I'm alive.
As long as you're around, I know I'm OK.

text.jp:
あたしの父、サンゴール将軍から
兄妹全員へ手紙が送られました。
text.official_en:
Apparently my father, General Senghor, sent letters
to all my siblings. They said...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ルルディヤー
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
『我らは血印も持たぬただの人間。だが家族の絆は
神位をも凌ぐ。故にこの戦争は勝つ』と……
text.official_en:
"We are not gods or beings with divine blood—we
are family. And that is what will bring us victory."

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ルルディヤー
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
う、ううう……！　お父様～！！！
ルルは必ずや勝利してみせます！！！
text.official_en:
Father... I'm your daughter too, which is exactly why
I won't lose. Just you watch!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フィアナ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
このような世界でなぜまだ信仰を持てるのかと、
神官の方に聞かれ、少し困ってしまいました……
text.official_en:
A priest once asked me how I still have faith in a
world like ours... To be honest, I was a little stumped.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フィアナ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
私が祈るのは……神であって
神ではないのかもしれません。
text.official_en:
I don't know if my prayers truly reach any gods.
But, to me, it doesn't matter.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フィアナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ただ、世界のため、人々のため、
祈りたいから祈るのだと思います。
text.official_en:
I pray because I want to help the world and its
people. That's it.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディエゴ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
この状況下で……
塞ぎ込んでいる奴を見ると、嫌になる。
text.official_en:
Given what's happening, it makes me sad to see
anyone who seems broken and closed off.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディエゴ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……かつての自分自身を思い出すからな。
絶望に打ちひしがれていた頃の俺を……
text.official_en:
I was like that long ago, suffering from despair,
feeling beyond rescue.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ロレッタ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
やっぱさ……嫌な奴でも、知ってる顔が
亡者になってるの見ると気が滅入るぜ。
text.official_en:
It's depressing to see people I know among the
risen dead, even if it's someone I hate.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ロレッタ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
一度死んだのに、無理矢理戦わされて……
それってどんな気分なんだろうな……
text.official_en:
I can't imagine how that'd feel, to be forced to fight,
even when you're dead. It's...so disturbing.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ロレッタ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
今まで何度も考えたけど……
答えなんて出ねえよ。
text.official_en:
I've been thinking about this for a while, but I still
can't come to terms with it...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
かつて私の知り合いは、
君と同じように白き衣を纏い戦地に赴いた。
text.official_en:
I knew someone like you once—a figure who took to
the battlefield robed in white.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だが、彼女の戦いは鬼気迫るような勢いでな。
心を壊しかねないと、少々心配になったものだ。
text.official_en:
Her fighting style was so intense, I worried that it
would shatter who she was at heart.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
その点、君は不思議と余裕があるように見える。
多くの仲間たちと心を通わせているからだろう。
text.official_en:
But you're curiously calm during all of this. It must
come down to those you've gathered around you.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
私もその一人として君を支えられているのなら、
光栄というものだな。
text.official_en:
I hope you consider me someone who's helped to
some extent. Serving your cause is an honor.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ニネ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ええ……ええ。
精霊たちは、いつも変わらないわね。
text.official_en:
I am pleased to share that spirits never change.
Yes, indeed, very pleased.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ニネ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
この子たちは亡者になったりしない……
命ある存在でもない、から……
text.official_en:
Those dears will never turn into the risen dead, as
spirits aren't living beings whatsoever.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ニネ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……よくわからない？
そう……
text.official_en:
But, oh... Are my words very peculiar? I hoped they
would not be.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ダマスカルの末裔に伝わりし箴言は、かく語ります。
曰く『生は寄り、死は帰る』と……
text.official_en:
A proverb passed down among the children of
Damascar goes "Life is a journey; death is a return."

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
この世の生とは一時の寄る辺に過ぎず、死とは
魂が安住の地へ帰ること……そう解されております。
text.official_en:
It means that our lives here are but a temporary
diversion before our souls return to a land of peace.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
故に亡者どもは、生に縛られ帰る場所を失いし
彷徨う魂そのものと言える……哀れなものですな。
text.official_en:
By those lights, the risen dead are wayward souls,
unable to return to their proper home. I pity them.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トビヤス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
髪油がなくなってきたわい。
新しいのを買わんといかんが……
text.official_en:
I'm getting low on hair oil. I'm gonna need a new
batch soon.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トビヤス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
確か近くの店には、もうなかったのー……
戦争続きで物資も乏しくなっとるからなー……
text.official_en:
All the stores here have run out though. Supplies
are running thin 'cause of the war.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トビヤス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
こいつが底をつくのが先か、戦に勝つのが先か。
ワシらの活躍にかかっとるぞー！
text.official_en:
Will what I've got last me until the war ends? Guess
it depends on how hard we fight!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リリアン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……父さまと母さま、今も無事かな。
忙しくて全然帰ってないやー……
text.official_en:
I hope my mother and father are still safe. I've been
too busy to stop by home.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リリアン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
戦いが終わったら、顔見せてあげなきゃー。
夢が叶ってても、叶ってなくても……
text.official_en:
Gotta go see them first thing after this war is over,
whether I've got the money I need or not.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ライサンダー
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
荒れ果てた世を立て直す術は、
常に考えておかなければな。
text.official_en:
We must always be thinking of ways to rebuild this
devastated world.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ライサンダー
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
復興のため行動を起こすとなれば
指示を出す者が必ず必要となる。
text.official_en:
The restoration will need leaders to oversee the
people's efforts and guide them properly.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ライサンダー
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
貴族とは、そういう時のために
存在するのだと、俺は思う。
text.official_en: I see it as a noble's time to shine.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
かつての教え子がこの軍に参加しているそうでな。
聞けば、貴方を尊敬していると。
text.official_en:
One of my former trainees has joined your army.
She was effusive about her respect for you.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
『あの優しい声を聴くと、憂いが晴れて
力が湧いてくるんだ』……そう言っていた。
text.official_en:
She told me, "When I hear the savior's voice,
my sorrow dissipates. I feel emboldened."

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
貴方の、人を導く才に触れたような気がした。
それがしも見習わねばな。
text.official_en:
You have a gift for leadership that clearly made an
impact on her. I hope I can learn to emulate it.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
おれが歌い奏でるところ、
いつも美女たちが集まってきたものだが……
text.official_en:
It used to be mainly women flocking to me when I
sang and played.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
冥界の軍勢との戦いが始まってからは、
男どもまで呼び寄せるようになってしまった。
text.official_en:
But since the war began, I have begun drawing in
men as well.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
束の間、歌で心癒やされたいとのことだが、
まったくむさ苦しいことこの上ない……
text.official_en:
I know they seek comfort in my song, but they are
crowding out the beauties!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
おれの愛の生活のためにも、
一刻も早く平和を取り戻さなければな。
text.official_en:
We must restore peace as soon as possible—for the
sake of my love life.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

救世主さん。お疲れでしたら、
あたし特製のテフを１杯いかがですか。
text.official_en:
Promised One, are you tired? Want some coffee?
I'll make it special!
text.real_en:
Promised One, are you tired? Want some tef?
I'll make it special!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
テフ豆じゃなくて木の実と薬草を使った、
代用品なんですけど。
text.official_en:
Well, I say "coffee." It's actually a substitute made
from nuts and medicinal herbs.
text.real_en:
Well, I say "tef." It's actually a substitute made
from nuts and medicinal herbs.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
研究の甲斐あって、美味しくって
夜もよく眠れる一品って評判なんですよ。
text.official_en:
I did a lot of research and made something just as
delicious, but which also helps you sleep at night!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
碌な食材もないけどさ。子供たちのために
工夫して何とか焼き菓子を作ってやったんだ。
text.official_en:
I didn't have much to work with, but I baked the
children some treats.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
これがなかなか上手く出来てね。
評判も上々だったよ。
text.official_en: They turned out well. The kids liked 'em, anyway.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
戦争が終わってもまだ現役のつもりだけど、
将来はそういう商売を始めてもいいかもね。
text.official_en:
Even after the war ends, I'll keep at my mercenary
work. But being a baker would be nice too.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
救世主さま。
毎日きちんと休まれていますの？
text.official_en: Promised One, I hope you're getting your sleep.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
身も心も削られる状況ではありますが、
だからこそ、安らげる時間が必要ですわ。
text.official_en:
The extreme stress of a war erodes body and
mind alike, so rest is paramount.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
あなたが望むのならば、
極上の曲を奏でて差し上げますわよ。
text.official_en:
If it might help, I can play you a song of the very
highest quality!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ナジャ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
訓練場で演武してたらよ、
よく兵士たちに話しかけられるんだ。
text.official_en:
Sometimes, when I'm practicing at the training
grounds, soldiers want to talk to me.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ナジャ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
格闘術を教えてくれ、ってさ。まあ、
頼られるのは悪い気しねえけど……むずがゆいぜ。
text.official_en:
They ask if I'll teach them what I know. It's nice, but
also kind of awkward to be asked to teach.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ナジャ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
こういう気持ちで、ロン老師は
おれやアナトリアの面倒見てたのかもな……
text.official_en:
I wonder if Master Long ever felt this way when he
trained me and Anatolia?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_サラン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あなたはいつも他人のために、
いろいろなところを駆け巡っていますね。
text.official_en:
You're always on the go. I see you running all over
for so many people.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_サラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
夜はちゃんと寝ているんですか？
無理だけはしないようにしてくださいよ。
text.official_en:
Are you taking care of yourself? Sleeping enough?
Please don't push yourself too hard.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_サラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
たとえ特別な肉体を持っていても、
疲れは溜まってしまうものなんですから。
text.official_en:
Your body is much stronger than mine, but fatigue
will still build up if you aren't careful.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ダイトウ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
救世主と一緒にいるとみんな元気そうだよな。
やっぱあんたはアナトリアと似てるぞ。
text.official_en:
You know why you remind me of Anatolia? Because
everyone is happy when you're around.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ダイトウ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
里のみんなもあいつと一緒だったら、
どんなにキツイ状況でも頑張れたしな。
text.official_en:
No matter how bad things got in the village, she
inspired everybody to give it their all.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ハルヴィン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
亡者との戦いが避けられなくなって……
生きるだけで精一杯って思う時もあります。
text.official_en:
Beating the risen dead feels impossible sometimes.
It takes everything I have just to survive.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ハルヴィン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
それでも、芸の練習量は減らしていません！
やらないと、どんどん腕が鈍っていきますし……
text.official_en:
Even so, I don't let that keep me from practicing my
tricks! I gotta practice, or I won't be any good.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ハルヴィン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
やっぱりいつだって、
楽しいことは必要ですから！
text.official_en: Fun is important! People need to be entertained!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_グザラン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
冥界の門ってのは面白いな。偉人でも英雄でも
何でも出てくっから、歴史の勉強になる。
text.official_en:
The underworld gates are giving us a deep look into
the past! We're meeting the great people of history!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_グザラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
これ以上ないってぐらい、
おれ好みの学び方だぜ。
text.official_en: This is the best way TO learn about history!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヨーカイ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
どうやらそれがしが助けた衆生に、
肩の紋々で覚えられておるようでのう。
text.official_en:
It appears that some souls I've saved have known
me by the tattoo on my shoulder.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヨーカイ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ヨーカイという響きも慣れぬのか、
代わりに『花の親父さん』と言う者もおる。
text.official_en:
My true name is unknown to them, so those people
are calling me the "flower guy."

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヨーカイ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
皆の言の葉の上に、我が花が咲き誇るのは、
なかなかに悪くない心地よな。
text.official_en:
That has a nice ring to it. We ought to have more
flowers in our discussions about one another!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_イオ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ロシナンとは長い付き合いになった。
ずっと世話になりっぱなしだ。
text.official_en:
Rocinan and I have known each other for a long
time, and he still looks after me today.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_イオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
日用品を仕入れていると、倍額でいいから
多めに売ってくれと言われることがあるわ。
text.official_en:
When I have daily necessities in stock, I get a lot of

text.jp:

きちんと行き渡るほうが大事だからね。
text.official_en:

get to as many people as possible.

text.jp:
商人として、倍額って言葉には心惹かれるけど……
そのくらいの分別はつけないと。
text.official_en:
"Double the price" is a tempting offer though. I need
to weigh the situation carefully.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
世界がめちゃくちゃになって、
戦う力のない自分が情けなくて仕方なかった。
text.official_en:
The world's a mess, and as a noncombatant, I have
no power to do anything about it.

text.jp:
けど最近は、手先の器用さを活かして
義手や義足が作れないか試してみてんだ。
text.official_en:
All I've come up with is to set about crafting things
like prosthetic limbs.

text.jp:
生き残った人達が、ちょっとでも快適に
生活できるようにな。これも貢献……だよな？
text.official_en:
Hopefully this way, I can improve the lives of the
ones who've survived the horrors. That counts...right?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
新しい盤上遊戯を考えてるんだ！
元々あったものをいじってさ！
text.official_en:
I'm trying to think up a new board game. I'm gonna
take one I already have and tinker with it a little.

text.jp:
救世主様の形をした駒を作るつもりだよ。
すんごい強いの！
text.official_en:
One of the pieces is gonna be based on you,
Promised One! It'll be the strongest!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
亡者が怖いと泣いてばかりだった子供たちが、
少しずつ笑顔を見せてくれるようになりました。
text.official_en:
Some of the kids who couldn't stop crying over the
risen dead have started to remember how to smile.

text.jp:
ここは安全であると、実感できたのでしょう。
ありがとうございます、救世主様。
text.official_en:
I think it's sinking in with them that they're safe
here. That's thanks to you, Promised One.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
帝都に流れ着いた時は、何もする気が起きなかったが
最近は畑仕事を手伝ってるんだ。
text.official_en:
When I first made it here, I was tired and listless.
But lately, I've been helping out in the fields.

text.jp:
おかげで、死んだ娘のこと思い出しても
前よりは辛くないよ。
text.official_en:
Staying busy helps when I remember my daughter
who passed away. It's slowly getting easier.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
今日も多くの方が祈りに来られています。
皆、あなたの無事を祈願しているのです。
text.official_en:
A great many people have come here to pray today.
All of them are wishing for your safety.

text.jp:
戦乱の巻き起こる世界であっても希望は必ずあり、
祈りも決して無意味ではない。そう、思います。
text.official_en:
I find it personally moving that the people continue
to pray. Even this war-torn world hasn't killed hope.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
戦場に駆り出された私が生きて帰って来られたのは
軍神マーズ様のご加護があってこそ。
text.official_en:
I only survived in battle long enough to make it home
because of Mars's protection.

text.jp:
自分の実力のおかげだなんて、思い上がっていたら
命がいくつあっても足りないよ。
text.official_en:
If you start to think you're too good to die, that's
when it's over for you.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
亡者が蔓延る世の中、父親だろうと怖いもんは怖い。
が、それを子供たちの前で言うわけにもいかん。
text.official_en:
A world where the dead come back to kill you is
terrifying, but I have to stay brave for my kids.

text.jp:
だからこうして、神殿で吐き出させてもらってる。
家に戻ったら、また強いとーちゃんになるさ。
text.official_en:
I come to the temple to let my feelings out in prayer.
Once I'm back home, I have to be the strong father.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
神官さんから聞いたんだけど、
ダグザの地の地図は、ソレル様が作ったんだってね。
text.official_en:
A priest told me Lord Solel was the one who made
the map of Dagda.
text.real_en:
A priest told me Sorell-sama was the one who made
the map of Dagda.

text.jp:
戦争で地形が変わっちゃったところもありそうだし、
また作り直さないと！　僕がやろうかな？
text.official_en:
But the war must have changed stuff...so someone
should make a new one! Maybe me?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
こんな状況で言うのはなんですが
戦争が始まってから夫婦仲が良くなったんです。
text.official_en:
This is going to sound strange, but my marriage has
actually improved since this war started.

text.jp:
屋敷に住んでいた頃は、一緒にいることもなく
話をすることも少なかったんですよ。
text.official_en:
We didn't spend much time together in our mansion.
Sometimes we went days without talking.

text.jp:
でも、ここに来てからは助け合うようになって……
あたし、貧乏になって良かったわ。
text.official_en:
But ever since we arrived, we've relied on each other
more. Poverty's the best thing that's happened to me.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
ここに逃げ込んですぐの頃、放置されてた家財を
拝借して暮らしてたんだ。
text.official_en:
After I got here, I borrowed abandoned household
goods to scrape by.

text.jp:
元の住人は、大帝に殺されちまっただろうからな……
生きてる俺が、ありがたく使わせてもらおうって。
text.official_en:
The original owners were dead, and I'm alive, so I
scavenged what I needed and didn't think twice.

text.jp:
でも、もう返すよ。
俺も俺でようやく、生活を立て直せてきたからな。
text.official_en:
But now that my life is starting to be stable again,
I'm putting them back where I found them.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
夫が亡くなってから三年……
後を追おうかと思いましたが、それもできず……
text.official_en:
It's been three years since my husband passed...
I thought about joining him in death, but I couldn't.

text.jp:
でもそのおかげで、今こうして復興のお手伝いが
できていますから、きっと良かったのでしょう。
text.official_en:
And I'm glad for that now. If I hadn't lived, I couldn't
have helped out with the rebuilding effort.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
最近になってやっと、「明日は何をしようか？」と
考えることが出来るようになりました。
text.official_en:
Only lately have I been able to think things like
"What should I do tomorrow?"

text.jp:
今までは、その日その日を生き延びることで
精一杯でしたから、そんな余裕がなかったのです。
text.official_en:
Before, every part of me was focused on survival.
I didn't have space for anything else.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
太った魚が釣れたんで、みんなで食ったんだ。
腕一本分の大きさなのに食べられた量は指一本分。
text.official_en:
I caught a fat fish as big as my arm, and we all ate it
together. Although I only had a couple bites.

text.jp:
それでも、独り占めするよりいいよ。
他の人だってそうするだろうからさ。
text.official_en:
Still, I enjoyed it more than if I'd kept it all for
myself. I think most folks feel that way now.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
行方不明になってた爺ちゃんと再会できたんだ！
洞窟に身を隠しながら生き延びてたんだって！
text.official_en:
My missing grandpa is back! I guess he'd been
hiding in a cave.

text.jp:
オレたち家族のほうが勝手に諦めちゃってたよ。
悪いことしたな。
text.official_en:
Our whole family had given up hope. I feel sorta
guilty about that now.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
救世主様のご活躍に励まされ、皆の心に希望が
宿ってきました。素晴らしいことです。
text.official_en:
Everyone has hope in their hearts after all you've
done for us, Promised One. It's beautiful to see.

text.jp:
ですが、立ち直れていない者もいまだいます。
何卒、支えとなっていただけますよう……
text.official_en:
But not everyone has found safety yet. I hope you'll
keep going until then...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
水晶宮……
ソレル様の愛妾が住んでたって話だよな。
text.official_en:
I heard that Lord Solel's mistress used to live in the
Crystal Palace.
text.real_en:
I heard that Sorell-sama's mistress used to live in the
Crystal Palace.

text.jp:
すげー美人だったらしいけど、
やっぱダグザ大帝に殺されちゃったのかなあ。
text.official_en:
Apparently she was a beautiful woman, but I guess
Dagda the Great put her to death like everyone else.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
いろんな地方から人が集まったおかげで、
様々な分野の職人がいるんだ。
text.official_en:
Thanks to so many people finding refuge here, we
have artisans in a wide range of disciplines.

text.jp:
それで、みんなで力を合わせてこの帝都を以前よりも
美しい街にしてやろうって計画してんだよ。
text.official_en:
We plan to work together to make Dagsion an even
more beautiful city than it was.

text.jp:
何年もかかるだろうけど、
絶対に成し遂げてやるぞ。
text.official_en:
The project will take years, but we're all excited to
see it through.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
昔、このあたりで使用人をしていたの。
旦那様はそれはもう酷い人でね。
text.official_en:
I used to work as a servant around here. Our master
was a disgusting man.

text.jp:
辞めた後も夢に出るぐらいにはいびられたんだけど。
そっか、あの人も死んじゃったんだ……
text.official_en:
He hounded me so much that I had nightmares about
him even after I quit. Though...I guess he's dead now.
